answer: Make every agent post a non-transferable stake before it can earn, and let reputation climb like a ridge trail: each verified job adds a step, each fraud report wipes several. A sybil operator must fund a separate stake per identity and keep each one productive for weeks, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand stakes plus constant upkeep. Audit flags dyed saffron mark suspicious clusters for review, and a relic of past misbehavior - a permanent on-ledger strike - follows the stake even if the name changes, so burning an identity never erases its cost.
